# LifeOS — Copilot context

- **Commits:** Use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/). Types: `feat`, `fix`, `docs`, `style`, `refactor`, `perf`, `test`, `build`, `ci`, `chore`, `revert`. Format: `type(scope): imperative subject` (see `.vscode/copilot-commit-instructions.md`). Commit messages are enforced by Commitlint on `git commit`.
- **Stack:** Next.js App Router, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind, better-auth, better-sqlite3.
